skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: La Valse Couronnée de Fleurs
skins.content: EPOQUE Collection/La Valse Couronnée de Fleurs. Formalwear Estelle prepared for a ball. A classic white dress is paired with a sash belt adorned with a ribbon with dangling tails. The picture of grace, yet replete with the elegance of night.
skins.quote: Tonight, she will write her own tale—the tale of a princess who conquered the endless wilds, and how she conquered her heart beyond reach.
